priorities.summary: In ConvertX before 0.19.0, converters/calibre.ts does not block .recipe/.downloaded_recipe files and passes them to Calibre's ebook-convert, enabling execution of arbitrary code embedded in recipe files. Disclosed Oct 3; no public exploit or KEV listing yet.

Cisco IOS XE command/OS/argument-injection flaw surfaced by Cisco's own AI-assisted internal security review, leading a seven-CVE hardening release across the 16.6.2–26.1.3 train (fixed in 17.9.10, 17.12.8, 17.15.6, 17.18.4/a, 26.1.2). There is no workaround — upgrading is the only fix.

Rejetto HTTP File Server 3.0.0–3.2.0 derives its session-cookie signing key from the non-cryptographic Math.random() generator and leaks generator outputs, enabling unauthenticated remote code execution (fixed in 3.2.1). VulnCheck observed exploitation in the wild starting Oct 1, within 24h of the Horizon3 disclosure.

model.name: DeepSeek Harness Desktop v0.2
model.summary: DeepSeek shipped v0.2 of its open-source Harness agent runtime as ready-to-run desktop installers for macOS (Apple silicon) and 64-bit Windows, adding in-app plugin installation/management, scheduled automation tasks, and an experimental mode where the agent writes plugins from conversation. The MIT-licensed repo sits near 242k GitHub stars, marking open-source agentic tooling crossing from developer tool to consumer product.
